title: ‘Best Shot Of My Entire Life’ Of Flipping Texas Blue, Says Rep. Greg Casar
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
With just weeks to go until the U.S. 2026 midterm elections, Texas **Rep. Greg
Casar** spoke to **Mehdi** in front of a LIVE audience in Houston, as Lone
Star State Democrats [James
Talarico](https://www.elpasotimes.com/story/news/politics/elections/2026/10/20/new-
poll-shows-james-talarico-ahead-of-ken-paxton-in-texas-us-senate-
race/92331780007/) and [Gina Hinojosa](https://www.texasmonthly.com/news-
politics/greg-abbott-gina-hinojosa-data-centers/) look to flip seats in the
U.S. Senate and Governor's mansion, respectively.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

But is this really the year Texas flips blue, Mehdi asks the very progressive
Casar, mentioning he's been hearing this for the entire 27 years he's been
visiting the Lone Star State.

**" This is our best shot of my entire life,"** says Casar, noting Texans will
have to turn out in massive numbers and beat out the influence of one of the
state's biggest Republican donors - [Elon
Musk](https://apnews.com/article/elon-musk-midterms-republicans-
donors-c06efc774a2e7c5d345e0d46641eb510). **" We can very much win this race,
but they're spending historic amounts of money."**

Casar, who is chair of the House Progressive Caucus, also spoke about how
money in politics, and the way DC operates, influenced the Democratic Party
and then-President Joe Biden's support for Israel despite the budding genocide
in Gaza.

**"[It] unfortunately results in people being treated in a sub-human way,"**
says Casar. **" That's why getting big money out of politics [and] tarnishing
AIPAC's brand and name the way we have, I think will save kid's lives."**

He also has some harsh words for ICE: **" We are talking about a rogue federal
force with a budget bigger than the United States Marine Corps, a budget
bigger than the military of most nations."**

Watch above to see Casar and Mehdi talk about:

  * His visit with [Wilbur Rafael Perez](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/sep/26/venezuelan-man-ice-shooting-austin-texas), a DoorDash driver shot by an ICE agent in Austin, at a federal detention center

  * His [bill](https://www.sanders.senate.gov/press-releases/news-sanders-casar-introduce-legislation-to-ban-artificial-superintelligence-and-temporarily-pause-advanced-ai-development/) with Sen. Bernie Sanders to ban artificial superintelligence and pause AI development

  * Whether AOC should run for president in 2028.
